title: Mexican-Style Stuffed Peppers
rawIngredients: 2 x 250g pouches lime & coriander cooked rice
400g can black beans, drained and rinsed
6 Mexican-style chilli cheese slices (or cheddar / monterey jack)
Salt and black pepper to season
method: Heat the oven to 220°C / 200°C fan / gas 7, or preheat an air fryer to 180°C for 4 mins.
Remove seeds and white pith from the peppers. Arrange cut-side up in a roasting tin or air-fryer basket, brush with oil, and season.
Bake in the oven for 20 mins, or air-fry in a single layer for 8-10 mins until softened and starting to caramelise.
Combine the cooked lime & coriander rice and rinsed black beans in a bowl.
Fill the softened peppers with the rice mixture and top each halved pepper with a slice of cheese.
Bake for an additional 10-15 mins in the oven (or air-fry for 3 mins) until the cheese has melted and the filling is piping hot.
Top the hot stuffed peppers with spoonfuls of fresh guacamole before serving.
